verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents several first-party bulk actions. Pulling down the repository list fetches all repositories, and any with new commits can be merged in a single tap (docs-51). The Resolve tool settles conflicts across many files at once (docs-7). Auto-Sync commits, pulls and pushes automatically when changes are detected (docs-33). These are narrow, specific bulk actions rather than a general multi-select or batch-operation capability, and none is shown being driven by the AI agent or by automation. Missing for 10: documented bulk push/commit across many repositories, multi-select batch file operations, bulk actions exposed through the Repository Agent or Shortcuts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
